name: Biology
question: What does biology establish about this subject, divided by the level or process the claim is about?
scqa_question: What single partition places every biological claim, practice and named field exactly once, and tells chemistry, medicine, mind and Earth where biology stops?
look_for: BI.O.A1 Heritable information
BI.O.A2 Cell
BI.O.A3 Organism
BI.O.A4 Descent
BI.O.A5 Ecological interaction
find_out: Comparison across lineages or gradients (M6 Compare and reconstruct)
rules_of_thumb: Central dogma slogan "DNA → RNA → protein". Fails for reverse transcription and RNA viruses.
"Form follows function." Fails where form is a phylogenetic legacy.
The 10 percent trophic rule. Measured range about 5–20 percent.
"One gene, one enzyme." Superseded by alternative splicing and multi-subunit proteins.
collisions: A relation that predicts a living outcome lives on Face O. A sequencer, stain or mark–recapture protocol lives on Face M.
Tissue, organ and organ system are parts of the Organism level, not extra levels.
Bond, equilibrium and rate law stay in chemistry. Biology starts where reactions are organised into heredity, a cell or a metabolism that reproduces. Uses CH.O.A3.3, CH.O.A4.2, CH.O.A3.
The genetic code and copying fidelity are BI.O.A1. Base-pair energetics, ATP coupling ΔG and enzyme kinetics are CH; BI cites.
Nernst is CH.O.A3.3. Resting potential and action potential are BI.O.A2.2. MS.O.A2 and MD.O.A1.3 cite BI.O.A2.2.
Allele-frequency change is BI.O.A4. Population numbers and growth are BI.O.A5. Human demography is MS.O.A5.
Heritability is BI.O.A4.2. MS.O.A3 cites it.
Virus-as-replicator claims are BI.O.A2.5. Virology is a catalog.
Normal function is BI.O.A3. Human failure, diagnosis and treatment is MD.O.A1. MD cites BI.O.A3 for the normal sentence.
Disorder, diagnosis and treatment of non-human animals is BI.O.A3.5. The drug substance and residue in human food remain MD.O.A4.1.
Neural circuits and systems are MS.O.A2. Non-human animal behaviour is BI.O.A3.4. Human behaviour is MS.O.A1.
Evolution is a claim about descent. A phylogenetic tree is a comparative method (BI.M.3) aimed at that claim.
Bond, equilibrium, rate law, molecular structure, Nernst → CH.O.A3.3, CH.O.A4.2, CH.O.A3
Physical law used in biophysics → PH
Human disorder, diagnosis, treatment; the drug chain → MD.O.A1, MD.O.A4.1
Neural circuits and systems; human behaviour; learning → MS.O.A2, MS.O.A1
Human population rates → MS.O.A5
Sequence algorithm; bioinformatics software claim → CS
Specified engineered biological function (synthetic biology, biomedical devices) → EN
Water balance, landform, stratal occurrence of fossils → EA.O.A4.2, EA.O.A3
